claim: Initial droplet diameter is dispensed to a nominal size with tolerance +/-0.25 mm and reproducibility +/-5% (FLEX-2 range 1.5-5 mm; FLEX-1 EIRD range 2-6 mm).
source_location: ERD sections 4.1.12-4.1.13 (Droplet Size Tolerance / Reproducibility); EIRD section 5.1.2 (Droplet Deployment and Ignition)
limitations: Specification-level evidence: the tolerance is a dispenser requirement, not a per-run measured uncertainty for the table value.
required_followup: Obtain the range/calibration record of the dispenser or the per-test analyzed-data diameter values.

claim: Imaging resolution requirement for droplet sizing is 30 um over the field of view, minimum frame rate 30 fps, back-lit view.
limitations: Requirement text; no pixel-scale/calibration file for the table's diameter values was found in the audited data.
required_followup: Locate the analyzed-data diameter time series and its scale factor.

claim: The experimental-table column 'Burning rate; mm' has no documented definition or unit in any inspected source document.
source_document: docs/flex/* (EIRD, Test Plan, ERD, DoD, Overall Ext File-2); analysis/audit/*; data/raw/flex/*
source_location: full-text search for 'burning rate', 'burn rate', 'mm/s', 'mm2/s' in all PDFs/docx/txt under docs/ and data/
limitations: The only nearby documentary evidence is the EIRD's d2-law burning-rate constant discussion in mm2/s (literature/derived context), which is NOT a definition of this table column; unit inference from the numeric magnitude (0.05-1.06) is explicitly prohibited.
required_followup: UNIT UNVERIFIED - PHYSICAL INTERPRETATION BLOCKED. Obtain the PSI-69 data dictionary or the analysis code that produced the table column.

claim: EIRD documents the d2-law average burning rate constant for FLEX fuels in air at 1 atm as 0.8 mm2/s and states droplet burning rates and extinction diameters are obtained from back-lit droplet-size time-series imaging.
source_location: EIRD section 9 (Justification for Reduced Gravity, p.64) and section 5.2.1
limitations: Supports that the experiment's burning-rate constant is an image-derived quantity with mm2/s-class units in the requirements context; does NOT verify the PSI table column's header or derivation.
required_followup: Confirm with the data originator whether the table column is this constant, a linear regression rate, or another scalar.

claim: Extinction droplet diameter is intended to be measured from the same back-lit droplet imaging as the burning rate.
limitations: Establishes measurement method class (image-derived) but not the specific reduction used for the table's single reported value.
required_followup: Obtain the reduced diameter time series behind the table value.

claim: Burn time in the table is a per-test scalar in seconds.
limitations: Header states seconds; two values carry a '~' approximation marker (6 s, 9 s) which is preserved as approximate in all analyses.
required_followup: Confirm the start/stop events defining burn time (ignition vs dispense; flame-out vs igniter-off).

claim: Ambient pressure is reported in mmHg in the table; the experimental requirement is 0.5-3 atm with tolerance +/-0.05 atm (ERD) and accuracy +/-0.01 atm (EIRD), maintained within +/-10% during a test.
source_document: docs/flex/FLEX Engineering Requirements Document.pdf; docs/flex/FLEX_EIRD_v4.pdf; data/raw/flex/PSI-69_Experimental table_FLEX.csv
source_location: ERD 4.1.34-4.1.35; EIRD 5.2.8; table column 'Ambient pressure; mmHg'
limitations: Unit (mmHg) is verified by the header; the tolerance figures are spec-level, not per-run calibration records. One record reports 0 mmHg (C11M201), physically implausible and flagged.
required_followup: Obtain chamber pressure calibration/verification records.

claim: O2 mole fractions are provided to 0.1-0.4 with an initial-charge tolerance of +/-0.005 mole fraction.
limitations: Spec-level tolerance; 29 table records have composition sums that do not equal 1.000 (not renormalised anywhere).
required_followup: Obtain the chamber gas charge/verification logs per run.

claim: The Test Plan documents an LOI-determination procedure using sequential, adaptive tests (burn-to-completion, finite extinction diameter, no-ignition), establishing what Extinction and Completion labels correspond to procedurally.
limitations: Describes the LOI procedure; does not define the table's three label values operationally.
required_followup: Obtain the analyzed-data record definitions for the label column.

claim: The outcome label 'Disruption' (61 records) is not defined in any inspected document.
source_document: docs/flex/* (EIRD, Test Plan, ERD, DoD, Overall Ext File-2); i_Investigation.txt
source_location: full-text search for 'disruption' returned no definition
limitations: Label is used as an analysis category in Phase 2 without a documented definition; its physical meaning is unknown.
required_followup: Obtain the definition from the investigation team or analyzed-data dictionary before using Disruption as a scientific category.

claim: The experimental table originates from the NASA PSI data system (psi.nasa.gov); the investigation overview describes FLEX experiment data records organised by GMT and/or gas mixture.
source_location: ontology/source reference lines and investigation description
limitations: No DOI, publication reference, or version identifier for the specific CSV export is recorded in the audit or the file.
required_followup: Record the PSI export date/version and a citable source reference.

claim: LOI determination is a sequential adaptive procedure in which each test's conditions depend on the outcomes of previous tests.
limitations: Direct documented evidence that the dataset is not a set of independently randomised runs; records within a series are procedurally dependent.
required_followup: Model the series structure explicitly in any future inferential analysis (e.g. series-stratified or permutation respecting series).

claim: Up to 9 records share a single test date and 81 series prefixes (campaigns) group the 274 records, so run-level clustering is plausible.
limitations: Clustering is demonstrated structurally; whether it materially affects Phase 2 p-values is assessed only via the 193F001 sensitivity rows.
required_followup: Quantify within-series correlation once per-run covariates are available.

claim: Two distinct records share FLEX identifier 193F001 (tests 70 and 73) with different measurements; joining on identifier alone would merge them.
evidence_type: recomputed from raw table + Phase 1 audit
limitations: Removing either record moves the initial-diameter fuel contrast p from 0.0623 to 0.0449 (Phase 2 sensitivity rows).
required_followup: Resolve the identifier collision with the data originator.

claim: Microgravity requirement: accelerations < 1e-4 m/s2 on three axes; measurement capability accuracy 1e-6 m/s2 exists per requirements.
limitations: No per-run g-level measurement is present in the audited data; the table has no gravity column.
required_followup: Obtain per-run ISS acceleration data if gravity effects are to be modelled.

claim: Fuels: n-heptane (sooting) and methanol (non-sooting), research grade, purity > 99.5%, degassed, dry, fuel temperature 18-27 C.
limitations: Spec-level; no per-run fuel lot certificates are available.
required_followup: Obtain fuel sample certifications.

claim: For the 8 telemetry-linked runs the testpoint setting FIBER_USAGE_FLAG is 'No' and soot-sampler flag is 'No'.
limitations: Fiber usage for the remaining 266 records is unknown (no equivalent column in the experimental table).
required_followup: Obtain fiber-usage metadata for all runs before geometric analyses.

claim: Phase 2 inferential p-values (Mann-Whitney, Spearman, Fisher) assume independent observations; with the documented adaptive series design and demonstrated clustering they are conditional on that assumption.
limitations: p-values remain useful as descriptive contrasts; they are not design-based confirmatory tests.
required_followup: Use series-respecting permutation tests once the series assignment is confirmed.

claim: All 9 records above 800 mmHg belong to a single mixture family (O2=0.21/N2=0.09/CO2=0.70/He=0); pressure and diluent effects are confounded in that region.
limitations: No independent pressure effect can be identified above 800 mmHg.
required_followup: Only within-family pressure variation can be examined; none exists for the high-pressure family in this table.

claim: Fuels share 31 of 52 distinct mixture families (115 MeOH / 106 Hep records in shared families) and 14 of 15 O2 levels.
limitations: Overlap is partial; 15 MeOH-only and 6 Hep-only families mean overall fuel differences are also condition-confounded.
required_followup: Restrict fuel comparisons to shared families (done in Phase 2 condition analysis).

claim: Ten matched-O2 CO2/He substitution cells exist; of these, 5 have identical reported N2 balances on both sides and 7 have at least 3 records per side; only 4 cells (O2 = 0.16, 0.17, 0.18, 0.24) satisfy both conditions.
evidence_type: recomputed from raw table + Phase 2 condition analysis
source_location: F_diluent_substitution_cell rows and validation_checks rows diluent_cell_*, diluent_cells_n2_matched, diluent_cells_min_side_ge_3
limitations: O2 agreement alone does not make a cell matched; N2 balance and pressure-band comparability are evaluated separately.
required_followup: Treat only the 4 fully-defensible cells as candidate diluent contrasts.

claim: Only 8 of 274 runs have per-run telemetry; all are 2009 ambient-air runs near 760 mmHg, so telemetry coverage is a biased subset.
limitations: Time-resolved analyses are restricted to this subset.
required_followup: Obtain telemetry for the remaining runs or restrict time-resolved claims to the 8 runs.

claim: Telemetry files use at least six distinct clock/time columns (PIP, MAIN_COMPUTER GMT, RADIOMETER_100HZ_FRAME, FCU, IPSU1/2/4 camera clocks, image reference clock), with observed offsets of about 2.25 s between PIP and radiometer frames.
source_location: time-stamp column headers; first two radiometer rows
limitations: No reconciliation map is available in the audited files; requirements specify GMT synchronisation to +/-0.03 s, but the observed files are not synchronised by default.
required_followup: Build and validate a clock-offset map before merging timelines.

claim: 23 zip archives contain TIFF (A/B series) and BMP (D series) frame sequences of 800-1290 frames each (~5.34 GB total), each with an embedded per-frame manifest .txt; 20CAL13A is absent and known FCI image frames are missing per its Readme.
limitations: Formats and structure established; no image-derived measurement exists until frames are actually extracted and validated.
required_followup: Extract a single validated run as a pilot before any bulk work.

claim: Spec-level pressure uncertainties: +/-0.01 atm (EIRD) and +/-0.05 atm (ERD) over 0.5-3 atm; chamber readings in telemetry are PSIA at ~1 Hz.
limitations: Specification tolerances, not calibration certificates; no uncertainty is attached to individual table pressure values.
required_followup: Obtain calibration records for the chamber pressure transducers.

claim: Spec-level composition tolerance: O2 initial charge +/-0.005 mole fraction; chamber purity requirements documented.
limitations: Applies to the initial charge; 29 table records have reported sums != 1.000.
required_followup: Obtain charge verification logs.

claim: Recorded outcome-label composition by fuel: Methanol 126 Extinction / 23 Disruption / 8 Completion; Heptane 60 / 38 / 19 (Fisher outcome-vs-rest p = 5.16e-07 Extinction, 6.62e-04 Disruption, 3.46e-03 Completion; Holm-adjusted 1.55e-06 / 1.32e-03 / 3.46e-03).
evidence_type: recomputed from raw table; arithmetic cross-checked against Phase 2 outputs
limitations: A property of the RECORDED LABELS only; labels are design-generated under the adaptive LOI procedure and 'Disruption' is undefined; this is not evidence about chemical extinction.
required_followup: None for the arithmetic; label definitions required before interpretation (see outcome-label evidence rows).

claim: Measured burn durations differ by fuel (Methanol median 12.1 s, IQR 7.85-17.90, n=155; Heptane median 7.5 s, IQR 3.30-11.25, n=111; Mann-Whitney U = 4838, p = 1.17e-09).
evidence_type: recomputed from raw table; cross-checked against Phase 2 outputs
limitations: The count/statistic is verified; the INFERENCE is conditional on the independence assumption (adaptive series design) and on the undocumented start/stop definition of burn time.
required_followup: Series-respecting inference; burn-time event definition.

claim: Anomalous records (0 mmHg pressure C11M201; eight 0-mm extinction diameters; one d_ext > d0) are retained everywhere with explicit flags and are excluded only in documented screened variants.
source_location: audit section 3; mode columns in Phase 2 CSVs
limitations: Whether these are placeholders or true values is unconfirmed; both as-reported and screened interpretations are preserved.
required_followup: Confirm with the data originator.
